verdict.rationale: Motion has built-in automated behaviors (task risk alerts, project off-track alerts, meeting caps, auto-scheduling) but these are fixed AI features rather than user-definable trigger→action rules; genuine custom automation appears to require third-party Zapier integration rather than a native rules engine. Missing for 10: a native rule/trigger builder documented with examples, evidence of user-defined conditional logic, and independent confirmation that Zapier-based automations work as described.
